title: Founding Ambassadors
meaning: Founding Ambassadors voluntarily support Ayinou’s mission of peaceful collaboration and constructive community change.
boundaries: This designation recognizes participation in an Ayinou program. Identity and public-figure verification, institutional verification, government appointments, and elected or platform roles follow separate processes. All members retain equal participation and voting weight. The designation provides no moderation powers, private access, ranking advantage, or endorsement of anyone’s claims.

criteria.peace: A commitment to peaceful community collaboration
criteria.rules: Willingness to follow the community rules
criteria.safety: Respect for members’ safety and privacy
criteria.experience: Relevant community, educational, cultural, technical, or social experience
criteria.representation: A commitment to describing the role accurately

fairness: Selection is nonpartisan. Wealth, follower counts, popularity, politics, ethnicity, and religion do not qualify anyone. We welcome different professions and communities without inferring sensitive traits.
selection: Authorized administrators document why each candidate was selected. Invitations are private and participation is voluntary. Public recognition requires verified identity and the member’s consent. Use the impersonation report on a profile to flag a misleading claim.
emptyDirectory: The directory will list ambassadors when they qualify and choose to appear publicly.
roleDetails: Participation starts privately. You decide whether to display the designation on your profile if you meet the public recognition requirements. The role gives you the same voting rights as other members.
inviteMessageHelp: Explain why you’re inviting this member. They’ll see this message inside their invitation.
emptyMine: If you’re invited to join the program, you’ll get a notification and can respond here.
responsibilities: Participation is voluntary. Follow the community rules, respect others’ safety and privacy, and describe your role accurately. Acceptance starts privately. You can leave at any time.
visible: Your designation is visible on your public profile and in the directory.
eligibility: Public recognition requires an active, discoverable profile and verified identity.
publicEligible: Meets the current public recognition requirements.
withdrawConfirm: Leave the program and remove your public designation?
reviewWindow: You can request independent reconsideration once within 14 days. Your designation stays revoked during review.

confirmImpact: I confirm this action for this member.

review.new_invitation: A future invitation is permitted. Your prior designation remains revoked.
